verdict.rationale: Unleash has an official MCP server documented at docs.getunleash.io/integrate/mcp (confirmed by probe). It lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices, which directly delivers connecting an agent via an official MCP server. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of the exposed tool set, setup and auth flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
